name: electron-demo
description: Demo of Electron PDF viewer using WebViewer SDK

fileAssociations.name: PDF Document
fileAssociations.description: Open PDF files with My Electron PDF App

scripts.copy-and-dist: npm run copy-webviewer && npm run dist
scripts.copy-webviewer: cmd /c "if not exist lib\webviewer mkdir lib\webviewer && xcopy node_modules\@pdftron\webviewer\public lib\webviewer /E /I /Y  && xcopy node_modules\@pdftron\webviewer\webviewer.min.js lib\webviewer /Y"
